premises: Cr atoms in 3d HEAs develop negative atomic stress, while other elements (Co, Fe, Ni, Al) develop positive atomic stress
This differential atomic stress drives local chemical short-range order (SRO) and Cr clustering
SRO and Cr clustering alter nucleation kinetics and promote formation of secondary phases from the BCC state
